title: fix(live-preview): anchor column grips to header cells
body:
## Summary

Move live-preview table column-selection and column-reorder grips from a synthetic standalone `<tr>` into their owning header `<th>` cells, so each grip tracks the column it controls through selection, resize, and reorder.

## Problem

- The standalone grip row was not the semantic owner of any content column. Width measurement, hover handling, and row targeting therefore relied on synthetic row indexes and could misalign grips from their columns.
- Column deletion must continue to work when CodeMirror owns focus. The document-level keydown handler is guarded for active table selection and editable-cell focus, and is removed when the widget is destroyed.

## Changes

- Render each `.nexus-col-grip` inside its corresponding header `<th>` as an absolute overlay.
- Remove the standalone column-grip row.
- Replace synthetic-row index lookups with semantic header/body row helpers.
- Add a 5px maybe-drag threshold: a Grip click establishes selection, while movement beyond the threshold starts custom column reorder.
- Preserve document-level Delete/Backspace handling for Grip-established column and row selection.
- Remove the document keydown listener when the table widget is destroyed.
- Preserve row Grip drag/reorder, range selection, cell editing, outside deselection, and the existing column-resize hit area.
- Column-resize behavior, Markdown serialization, public APIs, and runtime dependencies remain unchanged.

## Verification

pnpm test → pass (542 tests)
pnpm typecheck → pass
pnpm build → pass
pnpm build:electron-demo → pass
pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/test/editor.test.ts packages/core/test/live-preview.test.ts packages/plugin-search/test/plugin-search.test.ts → pass (164 tests)
git diff --check → pass

New or extended regression coverage in `packages/core/test/live-preview.test.ts` includes header-owned Grip DOM, Grip selection and column deletion, document-level Delete when the table wrapper does not own focus, keydown-listener cleanup on widget destruction, outside deselection, and DOM preservation during cell editing.

Electron demo verification covered header-owned Grip alignment, Grip-established column deletion, column reorder, row Grip reorder, outside deselection, and resize alignment.

The table-widget interaction rules were reviewed, with regression coverage and Electron verification included.

## Compliance

**AI assistance disclosure:** Codex assisted with reproducing edge cases and drafting the follow-up fixes and regression tests. Human maintainer review is requested and required before merge.

No new dependencies, build artifacts, secrets, or personal document data are included.

commits_at_first_review.message:
fix(live-preview): anchor column grips to headers

- Move column drag/selection grips from separate <tr> row into each
  header <th> cell (absolutely positioned overlay)
- Fix column width misalignment issue when column widths change
- Separate grip click from drag with a 'maybe-drag' pending phase:
  only enter full drag when mouse moves beyond 5px threshold, letting
  simple clicks select columns without triggering editing lock or
  cell blur. This fixes the Delete key focus race where grip mousedown
  caused cell blur → CM6 dispatch stole focus from wrapper.
- Add missing test cases: click-outside-to-deselect,
  selection-change-during-editing-no-rebuild
- Unify header row access using getContentRows()[0] instead of
  hardcoded table.rows[0]
- Adjust column grip position to be visible near top border of header
  cells
- Increase column resize handle size for better usability
fix(live-preview): clean up table keydown listener

@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+## Context
+
+`EditableTableWidget` currently creates a separate `gripRow` before rendering the table header. Width measurement, row-selection indexing, and hover visibility rely on that synthetic row. A separate row cannot reliably align its grip cells to the rendered content columns.
+
+## Decision
+
+Each header cell will own one `.nexus-col-grip` overlay. The grip uses the existing custom `mousedown` / document `mousemove` / document `mouseup` drag path and stays separate from the resize handle's hit target. Header hover controls grip visibility; drag start hides the header grips and drag end leaves them hidden until the next header hover.
+
+Table row access will be semantic: header cells come from the header row and body rows are selected by their data-cell role, rather than by an assumed row offset.
+
+## Non-Goals
+
+- Change column resize behavior or persisted widths.
+- Change row reordering, range selection, cell editing, or Markdown output.
+- Add public APIs, dependencies, or Electron-only behavior.
+
+## Risks and Mitigations
+
+- Moving grips changes table row indexing. Replace each affected numeric lookup and cover column selection and row drag in regression tests.
+- Grip overlays can intercept cell interaction. Keep their hit area limited, stop propagation only for grip events, and retain the existing resize handle's higher z-index.
+- Multi-frame mouse interaction can trigger CodeMirror widget replacement. Reuse the existing drag editing lock and verify it is released before dispatch.

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+# Change: Anchor table column grips to their header cells
+
+## Why
+
+The live-preview table widget renders column drag grips in a standalone table row. That row does not share the content column geometry after width changes, which can visually misalign a grip from the column it selects or reorders. The table-widget rules require a grip to be positioned relative to its header cell instead.
+
+## What Changes
+
+- Render each column grip inside its corresponding header cell and remove the standalone grip row.
+- Preserve existing column selection, custom mouse drag/reorder, resize handles, row grips, and keyboard deletion behavior.
+- Replace DOM-row-index assumptions that depended on the standalone row with semantic header/body queries.
+- Add regression coverage for the header ownership and the affected interaction paths.
+
+## Impact
+
+- Affected spec: `live-preview`
+- Affected code: `packages/core/src/live-preview-table.ts`, `packages/core/test/live-preview.test.ts`
+- Public API, dependencies, and Markdown serialization: unchanged.

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+# Live Preview Spec - Header-Owned Table Grips
+
+## MODIFIED Requirements
+
+### Requirement: Editable table column interaction
+
+The live-preview table widget SHALL render each column-selection and column-reorder grip inside the corresponding header cell, while preserving the existing table editing and selection behaviors.
+
+#### Scenario: Column grips follow their header columns
+
+- **WHEN** a Markdown table is rendered with live preview enabled
+- **THEN** every data column header SHALL contain exactly one column grip
+- **AND** the table SHALL NOT contain a standalone row used only for column grips
+
+#### Scenario: Selecting a column from its header-owned grip
+
+- **WHEN** a user clicks a column grip without moving the pointer
+- **THEN** the corresponding header and body cells SHALL become the active column selection
+- **AND** no cell SHALL enter text-editing mode
+
+#### Scenario: Reordering a column from its header-owned grip
+
+- **WHEN** a user drags a column grip over another column and releases it
+- **THEN** the Markdown columns SHALL be reordered once
+- **AND** the widget SHALL rebuild in the new order after its drag editing lock is released
+
+#### Scenario: Existing table interactions remain available
+
+- **WHEN** a user edits a cell, selects a cell range, clicks outside the table, or deletes a selected column or row
+- **THEN** the existing behavior SHALL remain available after the grip placement change
